$MIGR (Migration Portal Token) serves as the core liquidity migration standard within the Pons Labs V2 ecosystem. Powered by an advanced bonding curve launch model, $MIGR establishes a seamless pipeline from initial capital formation to permanent decentralized liquidity. Upon reaching the graduation threshold, the protocol triggers a trustless, atomic migration routine that automatically deposits and permanently locks accumulated reserves and liquidity into a dedicated Uniswap V4 pool—eliminating withdrawal risks and setting a new benchmark for trustless token launches.
